summary: A long football-themed single page for an art-deco sans drawn from the lettering of São Paulo's Pacaembu stadium: an editable hero with weight, size, italic and alternate controls, a story told in chapters over halftone archival photos, then a run of genuine football infographics (match carousel, legends picker, classic line-ups on a pitch, live league standings) that make the numerals and labels do real work. Teal, yellow and red throughout; every style is named after a Brazilian footballer.

A yellow cookie banner covers the bottom-right corner
